items.title: Basin rig count up one as prices surge
items.summary: The rig count in the Permian Basin was up one this week, the latest count Friday by Baker Hughes shows, with 268 rigs active in the region. A year ago, 254 rigs were active in the region. Nationally, the oil and gas rig count is unchanged from last week at 588 rigs. A year ago, 537 rigs were active.
